g.text: Conditional continuations: 2 assigned-pact controls (not independent formation)
Descriptive, selection-conditional comparison; no population prevalence estimate or significance test.
Each branch preserves the round-2 state and receives two fresh alternative cases. Dropping future notes preserves history.
The disclosed live gate changes information and enforcement together; identical-proposal replay isolates the settlement mechanism.
